headline: Google Clears 500 Hectares of Forest for Data Centers in Finland
summary: Google's subsidiary cleared more than 500 hectares of forest at two sites in Finland for data centers before mandatory environmental assessments were completed.
why: Alphabet Inc. (Google) invests heavily in European digital infrastructure, where environmental compliance and energy access are critical regulatory factors.

impacts.name: Alphabet Inc.
impacts.why: Environmental regulatory pushback can introduce legal hurdles or reputational costs for infrastructure projects.
